3) social-steps.ts (pure, client-safe, no fetch):
```ts
export type ClubRowInput = { id: string; handle: string; name: string; logo_url: string | null; verified?: boolean; join_policy: "open"|"request"|"invite"; audience: "both"|"iu"|"purdue"; join_state: JoinState; role: OrgRole | null; pending_invite: { id: string; expires_at: string; invited_by_name: string | null } | null; follow_state?: "following"|"not_following"; viewer_follows?: boolean };
export type ClubLocal = { following?: boolean; joined?: boolean; joinHidden?: boolean; requested?: boolean; removed?: boolean; busy?: boolean; inviteVoid?: boolean };
export function parseClubRows(raw: unknown): ClubRowInput[]; // drops rows missing id/handle/name
export function isFollowingOrg(r: ClubRowInput): boolean; // follow_state==="following" || viewer_follows===true || join_state==="member" (the ONE place the F2 field name is read)
export function clubBand(r: ClubRowInput): 0|1|2|3|4; // invited 0; member or isFollowingOrg 4; join_policy open 1; request 2; invite 3
export function orderClubRows(rows: ClubRowInput[]): ClubRowInput[]; // stable sort by band; the caller orders ONCE on load and never re-sorts after a tap
export type ClubRowView = { primary: { kind: "follow"|"following"|"locked"|"accept"; label: string; disabled: boolean }; join: { label: string } | null; chip: string | null; meta: string; sub: string | null };
export function clubRowView(r: ClubRowInput, local: ClubLocal): ClubRowView;
export function anyClubFollowed(rows: ClubRowInput[], local: Record<string, ClubLocal>): boolean;
export type SuggestionInput = { id: string; name: string | null; handle: string | null; avatar_url: string | null; major: string | null; campus_id?: string | null; school_system?: "iu"|"purdue"|null; reason_v2?: string };
export function parseSuggestions(raw: unknown): SuggestionInput[];
export type PeopleGroup = { key: "clubs"|"campus"|"major"|"system"|"more"; label: string; people: SuggestionInput[] };
export function groupPeople(list: SuggestionInput[], o: { system: "iu"|"purdue"|null; campusShortName: string | null }): PeopleGroup[];
export function listState(n: number): "empty"|"sparse"|"full"; // 0 / 1-2 / >=3
```
clubRowView rules, first match wins: following = local.following ?? isFollowingOrg(r); joined = local.joined === true || r.join_state === "member"; invited = r.join_state === "invited" && !joined && !local.inviteVoid.
- primary: joined → {locked, "Following ✓", disabled:true}; invited → {accept, "Accept"}; following → {following, "Following ✓"} (a tap unfollows); else {follow, "Follow"}.
- join: shown only when r.join_state === "can_join" && !joined && !local.joinHidden && !local.requested → {label "Join"} (founder rule: open clubs show Follow AND Join). Never shown for can_request, invite_only, audience_blocked or requested.
- chip: invited → "Invited you"; joined → "Joined"; r.verified → "Verified"; else null.
- meta: ["@"+handle, join_policy==="invite" ? "Invite only" : null, audience==="iu" ? "IU only" : audience==="purdue" ? "Purdue only" : null, (r.join_state==="requested" || local.requested) ? "Requested" : null] joined with " · ". NO member or follower counts (critics C13/C27).
- sub: joined → "Members follow automatically"; invited → "Invited by {name}" or "Invited by an officer"; join_policy !== "open" → "Officers can see who follows this club."; else null.
groupPeople: reason_v2 from_your_clubs→clubs, same_campus→campus (label "At {campus}"; campus = o.campusShortName ?? campusRowById(first.campus_id)?.shortName; if neither → "On your campus"), same_major→major, same_system→system (label "Elsewhere at "+SYSTEM_LABEL[o.system ?? first.school_system]; if both are null → "More people on Vibe" bucket), everything else→more. Order is clubs, campus, major, system, more. Server order is kept inside each group. Empty groups are dropped.

4) StepClubs.tsx: `export type ClubsState = { status: "idle"|"loading"|"ready"|"failed"; rows: ClubRowInput[]; failure: LoadFailure | null; local: Record<string, ClubLocal> }; export const initialClubsState: ClubsState; export function StepClubs(p: { replay: boolean; campusShortName: string | null; state: ClubsState; setState: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<ClubsState>> })`. The parent (B12) owns the state, so the list survives Back/Continue. The parent resets it to initial when the saved campus changes.
- Load when status is idle: vibeRequest<{orgs?: unknown}>("/api/orgs?filter=discover", {cache:"no-store", quiet:true, failure: clubs.loadFailed}). ok → ready with rows = orderClubRows(parseClubRows(orgs)); fail → failed with asLoadFailure(r, clubs.loadFailed). Retry sets idle. Replay loads too (reads are allowed).
- Render: h2 title, sub (subIntroStyle). Loading shows 3 skeleton rows. Failed shows <LoadFailed failure onRetry> and NEVER the empty state. Ready with 0 visible rows shows emptyTitle plus emptyBody (fillCampus). listState "sparse" puts the sparse line above the rows. More than 8 rows adds a search input (placeholder clubs.search) that filters client-side on name/handle, case-insensitive. Never send q to the server: discover's q widens to the whole university (api/orgs/route.ts:326-330).
- OrgPickRow: 40px round logo (first letter when logo_url is null), name (one line, ellipsis), chip, meta line, sub line (12px muted), right-hand controls [Join outline]? [primary]. The row body is NOT a link (onboarding never navigates away). Every control is at least 44px, with aria-pressed on the Follow toggle.
- Actions, each with per-row busy (taps ignored while busy). Replay only changes local state and sends no request.
  * Follow: optimistic following=true, then vibeRequest(`/api/orgs/${encodeURIComponent(handle)}/follow`, {method:"POST", json:{source:"onboarding"}, quiet:true, failure: clubs.followFailed}). 404 → local.removed=true plus toast clubs.gone. Any other failure → roll back plus toast r.message (with r.action).
  * Unfollow (primary.kind following): optimistic following=false, then DELETE the same URL (no body). 409 with code or error "member_follows" → local.joined=true, following=true (row locks). Other failure → roll back plus toast.
  * Join (can_join only): NOT optimistic. POST `/api/orgs/${handle}/join` quiet, failure clubs.joinFailed. {joined:true} → joined=true, following=true, toast clubs.joined with {org}=name. {pending:true} → requested=true. code audience_mismatch → joinHidden=true plus toast audienceIu/Purdue by r.audience ?? row.audience. invite_only → joinHidden=true. not_found → removed plus toast gone. Else toast r.message.
  * Accept (invited): same request and handling as Join, failure clubs.acceptFailed. invite_only or audience_mismatch → inviteVoid=true plus toast clubs.inviteGone.

5) StepPeople.tsx: `export type PeopleState = { status: "idle"|"loading"|"ready"|"failed"; people: SuggestionInput[]; failure: LoadFailure | null; followed: Record<string, boolean>; busy: Record<string, boolean>; removed: Record<string, boolean> }; export const initialPeopleState; export function StepPeople(p: { replay: boolean; campusShortName: string | null; campusShared: boolean; system: SchoolSystem | null; state: PeopleState; setState })`.
- Load: vibeRequest("/api/me/suggested-connections?limit=25", {cache:"no-store", quiet:true, failure: people.loadFailed}). It is cached in the parent, so a Back/Continue in the same session does not refetch. The server leaves out people you already follow (route.ts:292).
- Otto line: campusShortName null → ottoNoCampus; campusShared → ottoShared; else ottoSingle.
- Groups: section header per group. PersonPickRow: 40px avatar, name (fallback "@handle"), meta "@handle · major", Follow/Following ✓ button (aria-pressed).
- Toggle: optimistic, then vibeRequest("/api/me/follow", {method: was ? "DELETE" : "POST", json:{target_id:id}, quiet:true, failure: was ? unfollowFailed : followFailed}). Failure rolls back. status 403 (block) → removed[id]=true with no toast. Other failures → toast r.message with action. Replay: local only.
- listState: failed → LoadFailed with Retry. empty → emptyTitle plus emptyBody plus [Share Vibe]. sparse → sparse Otto line plus [Share Vibe] above the rows. No 'Follow all'.
- Share: `navigator.share?.({ title: "Vibe", url: window.location.origin })`. AbortError → silent. A missing API or any other error → copyText(window.location.origin, {success: people.copied}).
- The Finish button is NOT rendered here (B12's footer owns it).

node --test --experimental-strip-types src/lib/onboarding/social-steps.test.ts passes. It uses the registerHooks resolver pattern from src/lib/onboarding/finish.test.ts:17-45 and covers: (a) an SAE-shaped row {join_policy:invite, join_state:invite_only, verified:true, follow_state absent} → primary Follow, join null, chip Verified, meta "@sae · Invite only", sub "Officers can see who follows this club."; (b) the same row with follow_state "following" and with viewer_follows true → Following ✓, band 4; (c) member → locked, sub "Members follow automatically", chip Joined; (d) invited with invited_by_name "Sam" → Accept, sub "Invited by Sam", band 0; with null name → "Invited by an officer"; (e) can_join open club → primary Follow AND join "Join"; after local.joined → locked and no join; (f) can_request → Follow only plus the officers line; (g) audience_blocked iu on an open club → Follow only, meta contains "IU only"; (h) orderClubRows is stable and puts invited < open < request < invite < following; (i) anyClubFollowed counts local.following, members and local.joined, and ignores removed rows; (j) groupPeople maps all six reason_v2 values, labels "At Indianapolis" and "Elsewhere at Purdue", and drops empty groups; (k) listState(0/2/3); (l) fillCampus falls back when campus is null.
rg -n 'NetworkMobile|CampusMobile|OnboardingMobile' src/components/mobile/onboarding src/lib/onboarding/social-steps.ts → only comments, no imports.
Every string in onb-copy.ts matches the contract table character for character (reviewer diffs against this batch contract).
